raw_description: powershell.exe launched with -EncodedCommand flag by user jsharma, parent process winword.exe. Base64 payload detected.
Sequential connection attempts to ports 20-1024 from external IP 185.220.101.47 over 90 seconds.
Scheduled task 'WinUpdateSvc' created, executes C:\Users\jsharma\AppData\Local\Temp\svc32.exe every 15 minutes.
312MB uploaded via HTTPS to unrecognized cloud storage domain 'fileshare-backup-cdn.net' within 4 minutes.
Single blocked request containing UNION SELECT payload against /api/v1/reports endpoint. WAF returned 403.
Account 'svc-backup' failed authentication 6 times in 2 minutes from internal host FIN-WKS-0042, then succeeded.
Generic adware 'PUP.Optional.SearchBar' detected in browser extension folder and quarantined automatically.
S3 bucket 'corp-backups-2024' ACL changed from private to public-read by IAM user 'terraform-ci'.
User clicked link in email flagged post-delivery as credential-harvesting; landing page mimicked O365 login.
Process svc32.exe requested read access to lsass.exe memory space. Access denied by EDR credential protection.
FIN-WKS-0042 attempted outbound connection to 185.220.101.47:443, IP matches threat intel feed entry updated 6 hours ago.
Sales manager exported full contact list report at 4:02 AM local time, outside normal working hours pattern.
Automated scanner requesting known CMS admin paths (/wp-admin, /phpmyadmin) from single source IP, all 404.
Kernel driver 'gputools64.sys' loaded without valid signature, associated with GPU overclocking utility installed same day.
User 'svc-backup' added to Domain Admins group by 'jsharma' account, 90 minutes after the earlier failed-login alert.
